independent_contexts: one fresh writer per study, two ordered operations; a separate fresh reviewer per study
model: session default, no override; same model family, not cross-model or human assessment
browsing: prohibited for writers and reviewers; supplied evidence boundary
new_before_revision: new final saved before either revision input is read; self-reported order and hashes, not instrumented access logs
sources: new-evidence is intro/design/findings only; revision is actual author passage with full article extraction
delegation_basis: skill-creator Independent Forward-Testing for complex skill behavior; fresh contexts receive realistic request and raw inputs, no intended answer
